ranking.note: a point-scored ordered list: rank-biased overlap (p fixed in the round) for an open-set top-N, normalized Kendall tau distance for a fixed basket. skill = 1 - loss(entrant) / loss(last week's list). `matched` holds only entrants who answered every scored ranking round. When persistence is perfect the denominator is zero and the convention (`scoring.skill`) scores every entrant 0 for that round; `persistence_loss` is published so that is visible.
